cc:Work.dc:title: communication-ch2-iq-path
cc:Work.dc:description: Hilbert response -j sign(f), phase +pi/2 at negative and -pi/2 at positive frequencies. A real bandpass signal with separated triangular lobes at +/-fc becomes xa=x+j Hilbert(x), doubling the positive-frequency lobe and canceling the negative lobe. The complex envelope xL=xa exp(-j2pi fc t) shifts this lobe to zero; its baseband frequencies need not be positive only.
